title: Hearty Savory Japanese Chicken Tendon
description: A savory Japanese dish from the Kansai region featuring chicken tendon, served in a cazuela with toast and a hint of dark chocolate, low in sodium and perfect for meal prep. This hearty meal is a unique twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cazuela, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the chicken tendon to the cazuela and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the soy sauce, sake, and mirin to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, toast the whole wheat bread until crispy.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and stir in the dark chocolate chips until melted.
Serve the chicken tendon hot, topped with toasted bread, green onions, and a drizzle of the savory sauce.
Garnish with additional green onions if desired.
